_source: DDO Wiki item infoboxes, read 2026-10-13 through the in-app Browser pane (#871).
_why: gear-planner c36b45e reads these Night Revels items at ml 1 with no quest. Their pages were reformatted on 2026-10-12: the infobox parameter `minlevel` became `minimum level` and the quest line became `turn in collector :: Joe Candymaker` with a {{Night Revels recipe}}. Upstream's parser reads the old names, so it fell back to ml 1. The wiki still STATES each level outright; this restores it, and restores the quest the previous snapshot (397c673) carried. Each entry names the upstream value it expects to find (`from`), so it fails loudly the moment upstream changes again, and goes stale (also failing the build) once upstream ships the corrected value, at which point it is deleted.
